integrity: The all-parameter argument is analytic. Exact-rational finite tests are corroborating checks, not a substitute for proof. Priority comparisons include the originating model, classical direct-distance DW, convergence results for its heterogeneous version and an independently studied Bernoulli-convolution opinion model.
scientific_limitations: Fixed three-vertex undirected path, one independently uniformly selected edge per update, no rewiring, homogeneous directional mixed confidence with the parameter wedge stated in RESULT.md. Does not classify parameters outside this wedge, larger graphs or synchronous updates; no claim of total-variation convergence at finite times.
title: Uniform stationary volatility in a three-vertex neighborhood-confidence path
